dct_title_s: Plan of lots of the Avalon Improvement Co. Avalon, N.J. III
dct_description_sm: Map of Avalon showing grants for real estate lots 25-41 between Twenty Fifth and Forty Second Street. Map covers area from Twenty Fifth Street to the north, Forty Second Street to the south, Fourth Avenue to the west, and Boulevard to the east.
